warnings.why: A domestic water share of 165 percent is conceptually impossible for domestic sector use alone, as domestic withdrawals typically represent a small fraction of total water use and cannot exceed total renewable resources by such a margin for municipal and household purposes.
A domestic share of 100 percent implies zero water use for agriculture or industry, which is implausible for any national economy.
